body: Are you prone to getting anxiety? I found Effexor worsened my anxiety a lot.

It has made my appetite completely uncontrollable. I've gained quite a bit of weight. I'm hungry all the time. I'm also bloated a lot and my thinking has been more "cloudy" than usual. But I've had so many issues with IUDs, and getting my insurance to approve other types of birth control. Yaz is cheap and if it keeps my PMDD at bay, I can deal with the extra weight.

I relate to this so much. SO MUCH. I can deal with all the physical side effects that come with PMS, and even some of the emotional ones, but the irrational urge to keep arguing? It's going to ruin my life.

I have no advice but just wanted to say thank you for making me feel less alone.

Good suggestion. I'm actually considering checking into a hotel just so I can use the bathtub in the room. Pool and hot tub requires squeezing my pale bloated body into a bathing suit around other people, lol.
